name: What cabinet materials hold up best to Florida humidity?

mainEntity.name: What cabinet materials hold up best to Florida humidity?

acceptedAnswer.text: In humid subtropical climates like the Tampa Bay area, kitchen cabinetry must handle ambient moisture and air conditioning cycling. Solid wood door frames paired with high-grade plywood box construction perform well against regional humidity shifts, resisting the swelling, sagging, or delamination common in low-density particleboard. Factory-applied, moisture-resistant finishes and marine-grade or sealed backer panels protect against moisture behind sink bases and exterior-facing walls. Selecting durable hardware with corrosion-resistant coatings also prevents premature tarnishing or hinge binding in coastal and humid environments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plywood boxes with solid hardwood frames and factory-sealed, moisture-resistant finishes handle Florida humidity far better than standard particleboard.
